decision.criteria: Pass if both giraffes' spot patterns and substantial interior shading are visibly re-expressed through chalk marks, layered strokes or form-describing rubbed shading. Chalk contours alone do not satisfy this condition. Return unknown only if visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
